serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Unanet GovCon ERP is a SaaS solution delivered in a multi-tenant, Government-Only cloud environment that supports government contractors with project management, accounting, timekeeping, labor and expense management, procurement, and business intelligence capabilities.
Contractors can securely manage contract information and maintain compliance with DFARS, DCAA, DCMA, and CMMC requirements.
It is available to the public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, government contractors.
